overview.title: Score GPT-2 medium
overview.summary: Load GPT-2 medium (350M) and exit after one score.

sections.title: Score GPT-2 medium
sections.pseudocode:
Use a batch of 8.
Score 500 batches, enough for a steadier estimate.
Stop after that first score.
Leave the run log off.
Start from the gpt2-medium weights.
# Insight: eval_only makes train.py measure loss and exit. It does not take an optimizer step.
